run_locobot_agent: run the locobot agent with a specified backend like habitat or hellorobot via command line
init_locobot_agent: create a LocobotAgent instance with parsed options and an optional name for the agent
perceive_locobot: run the perceive method to process vision, language, and self-perception modules and update memory
init_event_handlers_locobot: register Socket.IO event handlers for movement commands, shutdown, label propagation, and detector switching
shutdown_locobot_agent: call shutdown to stop the vision process and exit the agent cleanly
